title: AgentOS Controller next-lifecycle handoff
description: Project-agnostic proof that a bounded local successor started its next lifecycle turn before the current dispatch closed.

state_rules.start: A local dispatch may close only after an executable starter returns status STARTED, binds the final persisted receipt, names the registry handler, and proves started_same_turn=true.
state_rules.failure: A missing, null, stale, placeholder, or mismatched handoff is a workflow dead-end and must route to Controller bounded workflow repair or Orchestrator campaign repair intake; it is never a lifecycle-executor handoff, timer, or approval wait.
